Calendar.invitationsFailed: Your lesson invitation setting could not be saved; your previous choice is kept.
Calendar.invitationsHelp: The sessions of the courses you are enrolled in arrive at your e-mail address as invitations you can add to your calendar, with an update when a session is moved or cancelled. The meeting link is not in the invitation; it is on the session page.
Calendar.invitationsOff: Lesson invitations are off; no more invitation e-mails will be sent.
Changes.note: “Save” writes your first and last name to tedrisat; the rosters of your courses see this name. The name on your Keycloak account does not change. The time zone and the lesson-invitation switch are saved the moment you change them; with invitations off, no more invitation e-mails come. The language is kept only in this browser, in a cookie. “Change” or “Add” takes you to Keycloak's profile page: the gender you save there is written to your account, tedrisat copies it, and overwriting an earlier gender goes to the audit log. You can change all of it here again.
Gender.fromAccountHelp: Read only. Your gender is kept in your account. “Change” takes you to your account’s profile page; once you save, you come back here.
